lesson_intro.heading: Cloud Operations Associate · PM-4.3
lesson_intro.board_text:
Access Control and Incidents
Finova · finova-dev · ap-south-1

Why before how:
Access Denied and leak tickets land on Ops first.

Mental model:
Identity policy + bucket policy + BPA — all three matter.

You will: watch → learn → practice one navigation.
lesson_intro.ren_voice: I am Ren. Access Denied and leak tickets land on Ops first. Mental model: Identity policy + bucket policy + BPA — all three matter. I demonstrate, then you practice. Least privilege and Region discipline stay non-negotiable.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
Access Control and Incidents
• Identity policy + bucket policy + BPA — all three matter.
• Mistake: Widening bucket policy to * to 'unblock' a ticket.
• Habit: Reproduce with the principal's identity — then tighten, never *.
whiteboard_intro.ren_voice: Board picture: Identity policy + bucket policy + BPA — all three matter.. Juniors usually: Widening bucket policy to * to 'unblock' a ticket.. Your habit: Reproduce with the principal's identity — then tighten, never *..

segments.title: Open S3
segments.setup_voice: Watch — we open S3 the way a real ticket starts.

steps.voice: Navigate to S3. Confirm Region ap-south-1 before you trust the empty list.
Create bucket carefully — naming and blockers prevent future incidents.

segments.lesson_voice: Incident: contain public exposure first, then root-cause policy.

check.voice: Why is Principal * on a bucket policy dangerous?
check.response_if_correct: It can open access far beyond the ticket — blast radius.
check.response_if_incorrect: Wildcard principal = potential public or cross-account blast.

steps.voice: Someone set Principal * to fix a partner integration — weekend incident.
